name: Template-Free NeRF (TFS-NeRF)
definition: A template-free 3D semantic NeRF for dynamic scenes captured from sparse or single-view RGB videos, featuring interactions among two or more entities (rigid, non-rigid, or deformable). It uses an Invertible Neural Network (INN) for Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) prediction to bypass complex root-finding optimizations, enabling time-efficient training and semantically separable geometry reconstruction.
summary: TFS-NeRF reconstructs dynamic scenes from sparse RGB videos by using an invertible neural network to predict skinning weights, avoiding template models and expensive root-finding optimizations.
